NAME: scheduler_false_green
ROOT_CAUSE_STATEMENT: Coverage is inferred from workflow metadata or a mutable installed script rather than durable terminal evidence and attested control-plane bytes
PRIMARY_RISK: False-positive operational success or missed recovery

NAME: recovery_commit_semantics
ROOT_CAUSE_STATEMENT: Commit-last and create-only writes do not cover every crash window and nonterminal state is sealable
PRIMARY_RISK: Duplicate provider history or permanently incomplete slot

NAME: mutable_control_plane
ROOT_CAUSE_STATEMENT: Canonical workflows accept mutable refs/inputs or manual paths without a single immutable approved producer boundary

NAME: data_gate_and_identity_semantics
ROOT_CAUSE_STATEMENT: Generic helpers lack strict type, calendar, instrument-scope, interval, conflict, and pagination enforcement

NAME: evaluation_provenance_and_metrics
ROOT_CAUSE_STATEMENT: Evaluation admission and pure metrics do not fully enforce producer/data/state linkage or declared eligible denominators
PRIMARY_RISK: Invalid prospective evidence or incomparable statistics

NAME: workflow_registry_and_documentation
ROOT_CAUSE_STATEMENT: GitHub registration and coordination snapshots are not reconciled with current main/PR heads
PRIMARY_RISK: Operator selects stale or unknown control surface

NAME: ca_basis_lineage_and_authority
ROOT_CAUSE_STATEMENT: CA source ontology, basis semantics, population lineage, and date-level authority remain partially unresolved
PRIMARY_RISK: Historical training-input identity cannot be admitted

NAME: provenance_self_description
ROOT_CAUSE_STATEMENT: Stored evidence does not always self-describe the exact bytes and controlling workflow/ref needed for replay
